site.name: ForestWatch Sri Lanka
site.footer: ForestWatch Sri Lanka. Environmental records are official when a Forest Officer verifies them.

home.intro: A national platform for recording where trees are planted, monitoring whether they survive, and verifying the record in the field.
home.stepPlantBody: Citizens, schools, NGOs, and agencies register a tree or a restoration site.
home.stepRecordBody: GPS, administrative division, species, and photographs are stored against the site.
home.stepMonitorBody: Return visits add a timeline. History is never overwritten.
home.stepVerifyBody: Forest Officers review submissions for their assigned geography.
home.questBody: An original field-engagement layer for discovery, stewardship, and learning. It never replaces Forest Department verification.
home.verifiedRecordBody: These figures are queried from NestJS. They are not sample numbers.

coming.title: This section is not connected yet
coming.body: Live plantation data, maps, and accounts arrive in later phases — this page does not show sample numbers.

about.body: The platform is built so that planting counts are never the only number that matters. Location, species, survival estimates, photographs over time, and officer verification sit on the same record.

auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, including a letter and a number.
auth.verifyEmailBody: The account was created. There is no SMTP server in this environment, so the verification link is shown here instead of being emailed.
auth.checkEmail: Check your email to verify the account. SMTP is not configured here.

locations.title: Administrative divisions
locations.intro: Province, district, Divisional Secretariat, and Grama Niladhari records used when a plantation is registered. GPS is stored separately and is not inferred from these codes.
locations.catalogue: Catalogue: {provinces} provinces, {districts} districts, {dsds} DSDs, {gnds} GNDs from {source}.

species.title: Species
species.intro: Catalogue of trees used in restoration records. Plantation counts are live join-table rows, not estimated plantings.
species.heading: Species

impact.title: Impact
impact.intro: Live counts from NestJS over verified plantation rows. Estimated surviving trees come from the latest verified monitoring estimate, not from treeCount. Empty means nothing is recorded yet.
impact.noEstimate: No verified monitoring estimate in this filter
impact.noCampaigns: No public campaign has a verified plantation in this filter.
impact.emptyYear: No verified plantings in this filter.
impact.emptySpecies: No species quantities on verified sites.
impact.emptySurvival: No verified survival estimates yet. This is not a copy of treeCount.

search.title: Search
search.intro: Server-side results with pagination. Queries shorter than two characters are rejected so this page cannot dump a catalogue.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Role-specific live counts. ForestQuest confirmed XP is a ledger projection and starts at zero. Officer maps use the same coordinate visibility rules as the public map.
dashboard.signInFor: for your contributions. The public impact board is on
dashboard.questNotConnected: ForestQuest profile, XP, and badges are not connected in this phase.
dashboard.noCalendar: Past visits. There is no predicted inspection calendar.
dashboard.noInspections: No inspections in this assignment yet.
dashboard.noAudit: No audit rows for your account yet.
dashboard.questAdminNote: ForestQuest activity and engagement anti-fraud are not available yet.

forestquest.title: ForestQuest
forestquest.intro: ForestQuest is a field layer: walk to verified plantations, stay inside the on-site ring, then monitor. Confirmed XP is a ledger projection. EcoPoints are non-monetary reputation.
forestquest.rewardsPaused: Pending events are not rewards. Confirmed XP comes from verified field activity.
forestquest.rewardsActive: Confirmed XP and EcoPoints come from verified field activity. There is no client endpoint to add XP.
forestquest.forestDexIntro: Species unlock after an on-site visit to a verified plantation. Tapping a map marker does not count. Discovery XP confirms from that verified on-site visit.
forestquest.forestDexLockedHint: Visit a verified plantation on site to unlock this species.
forestquest.missionsUnavailable: Missions are not connected in this phase.
forestquest.badgesUnavailable: Badges are not connected in this phase.
forestquest.missionsIntro: Mission progress is counted from verified field activity. Completing a mission in the client does not award XP.
forestquest.badgesIntro: Badges are awarded from configurable rules after confirmed activity. Clients cannot award badges.
forestquest.noBadges: No badges in the catalogue yet.
forestquest.ecoPointsHint: EcoPoints are reputation points, not money.
forestquest.passportUnavailable: Forest Passport is not connected in this phase.
forestquest.noAddXp: There is no client endpoint to add XP.
forestquest.fieldIntro: Walk to a verified plantation. The inner ring is on site. The outer ring is nearby. Tapping a map marker does not count as a visit.
forestquest.shareLocationHint: Share location to place you on the field and list sites around you. Coordinates are not invented.
forestquest.locationDenied: Location permission is required. Coordinates are not invented.
forestquest.onSiteHint: You can submit monitoring from this site. NestJS still measures the distance.
forestquest.nearbyHint: Close enough to see the site. Walk into the inner ring for an on-site visit.
forestquest.remoteHint: Too far for an on-site visit.
forestquest.noNearbySites: No public plantations in this search radius.

mobile.homeBody: Field GPS and photographs queue in SQLite when the radio is down. Distance and verification still belong to NestJS. ForestQuest is not in this phase.
mobile.guestBody: You are a guest. Sign in to submit monitoring, reports, and officer inspections.
mobile.tokensNote: Tokens are stored in SecureStore on device. Refresh uses clientChannel mobile, not a web cookie.
mobile.loginMuted: Field sessions use a JSON refresh token in SecureStore. This is not the web cookie channel.
mobile.impactIntro: Live verified totals. Estimated surviving trees are not a copy of recorded treeCount. ForestQuest is not in this phase.
mobile.searchIntro: NestJS search. Two characters minimum. This list is paginated and is not a full table dump.
mobile.dashboardIntro: Live contribution counts. ForestQuest confirmed XP is a ledger projection and starts at zero.
mobile.questBody: This is your ForestQuest profile. ForestDex counts live catalogue species. Confirmed XP stays a SUM of confirmed ledger rows.
